#repeater event
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2003
	title = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2003.t
	desc = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2003.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OFFICIAL_GERMAN_1_eventPicture

					


	
	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = cosmo_dig_persistant_affair
		NOT = {
			has_country_modifier = having_an_dignitary_affair
		}
		}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
	days = 1
	}
	
	
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							any_known_country = {
								ai = no
								reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
									who = ROOT
									modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
								}								
							}
						}
					}
					clr_country_flag = cosmo_dig_persistant_affair
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_known_country = {
							ai = no
							reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
								who = ROOT
								modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
							}								
						}
					}
					random_known_country = {
						limit = {
							reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
								who = ROOT
								modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
							}
						}
							save_event_target_as = dignitarycountry
						}
						add_opinion = {
							who = dignitarycountry
							modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
						}
				}											
				}
				}

	option = {#send prostitute
		name = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2003.a
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						any_known_country = {
							ai = no
							reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
								who = ROOT
								modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
							}								
						}
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = cosmo_dig_persistant_affair
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_known_country = {
						ai = no
						reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
							who = ROOT
							modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
						}								
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { 
					name = having_an_dignitary_affair
					duration = 120  
					hidden = yes

				}				
				event_target:dignitarycountry = {
					country_event = {
						id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2004
						days = 5
						random = 35	
						}						
				}				
			}																											
	}				
}

country_event = {
	id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2004
	title = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2004.t
	desc = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2004.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OFFICIAL_GERMAN_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes

	hidden = yes
					

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		}


	
	
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							any_known_country = {
								ai = no
								reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
									who = ROOT
									modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
								}								
							}
						}
					}
					clr_country_flag = cosmo_dig_persistant_affair
				}
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_dignitary_persistant_opinion
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = dignitarycountry
				}			
				}
				}

	option = {#send prostitute
		name = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2004.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ruler_flag = hire_diplomat_prostitutes
					has_country_modifier = recently_visited_brothel
				}
			}
			FROM = {#we are busy
				country_event = {
					id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2005
					days = 10
					}
			}			
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_ruler_flag = hire_diplomat_prostitutes
					has_country_modifier = recently_visited_brothel
				}
			}
			set_ruler_flag = hire_diplomat_prostitutes
			if = {
				limit = {
			FROM = {
				OR = {
				advisor = trader 	
				advisor = statesman 	
				advisor = naval_reformer 	
				advisor = spymaster 	
				advisor = colonial_governor 	
				advisor = diplomat 	
				advisor = navigator 	 	
				}
				}
				}
					set_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_dip_advisor
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_dip_advisor
				}	
			FROM = {
				OR = {
				advisor = philosopher 	
				advisor = natural_scientist 	
				advisor = artist 	
				advisor = treasurer 	
				advisor = theologian 	
				advisor = master_of_mint 	
				advisor = inquisitor 	 	
				}
				}
				}
					set_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_adm_advisor
				}							
			if = {
				limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_dip_advisor
					has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_adm_advisor
				}	
			FROM = {
				OR = {
				advisor = army_reformer 	
				advisor = army_organiser 	
				advisor = commandant 	
				advisor = quartermaster 	
				advisor = recruitmaster 	
				advisor = fortification_expert 	
				advisor = grand_captain 	 	
				}
				}
				}
					set_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_mil_advisor
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_dip_advisor
					has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_adm_advisor
					has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_mil_advisor
				}	
			FROM = {
				OR = {
					has_heir = yes	 	
					heir_age = 18
				}
				}
				}
					set_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_heir
				}							
			FROM = {
				add_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = dignitary_entertained
				}			
			}
			country_event = {#additional option menus
				id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2000				
				}			
		}																													
	}				
}

				has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_adm_advisor
				has_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_mil_advisor
			}

							OR = {

							government = tribal
							government = native
							government = republic

			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.21098
			}																																												
	}

			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.20
			}

			}	
		event_target:dignitarycountry = {
							OR = {
								has_heir = yes
							government = tribal
							government = native
							government = republic
							}
			}
			}
				set_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_heir
			}		
		if = {
		limit = {
		event_target:dignitarycountry = {
			NOT = {
				has_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					value = 170
				}	
		}
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = entertain_dignitary_increase_opinion
		country_event = {#prostitute menus
			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.201
			}		
       }
		if = {
		limit = {
		event_target:dignitarycountry = {
				has_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					value = 170
				}	
		}
		}
		country_event = {#additional option menus
			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.200
			}		
       }	   																					
	}
	option = {#add country modifier 30 day if other
		name = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2108.b	
		trigger = {
						any_known_country = {
							OR = {
								ai_attitude = {
									who = ROOT
									attitude = attitude_friendly
								}
								ai_attitude = {
									who = ROOT
									attitude = attitude_loyal
								}
								ai_attitude = {
									who = ROOT
									attitude = attitude_threatened
								}
								has_opinion_modifier = {
									who = ROOT
									modifier = improved_relation
									value = 30
								}
								is_neighbor_of = ROOT
								alliance_with = ROOT
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							}
							OR = {
								has_advisor = yes 
							OR = {
							AND = {
								has_heir = yes
								heir_age = 18
							}
							government = tribal
							government = native
							government = republic

							}		
							}
							capital_scope = {
								OR = {
								region = scandinavia_region
							}
						}
						NOT = {
						has_ruler_flag = this_country_dignitary						
						}
						}
		}
		event_target:dignitarycountry = {
		hidden_effect = {
		add_country_modifier = { 
			name = not_this_country
			duration =  30
			desc = not_this_country_DESC

			}
		}	
		}
		set_ruler_flag = return_dignitary_scandinavia
		country_event = {
			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.21098
			}																																												
	}
	option = {#return to base menu
		name = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2108.c	
		country_event = {
			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.20
			}																																												
	}			
}

			duration =  30
			desc = not_this_country_DESC

			}
		}	
		}
		set_ruler_flag = return_dignitary_peru
		country_event = {
			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.24098
			}																																												
	}
	option = {#return to base menu
		name = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.2408.c	
		country_event = {
			id = cosmo_brotheldignitary_events.20
			}																																												
	}
